suites.label: Svelte preview docs harness
suites.consumerShape: browser review surface for direct Poodle evaluation
blockers: This harness is route-based review evidence, not screenshot-regression or GPUI runtime proof.
It does not prove downstream host integration beyond the preview shell.

suites.label: Underlay bridge-mediated adoption
suites.consumerShape: bridge-owned wrapper adoption inside an existing downstream app stack
blockers: Real downstream wrapper translation and assistive-technology evidence still belong to Underlay rollout work.

suites.label: Loophole foundation adoption
suites.consumerShape: direct downstream Svelte adoption on top of Poodle primitives and composites
blockers: DAW-specific widgets and runtime behavior remain downstream-owned and therefore outside Poodle acceptance proof.

suites.label: GPUI multi-app validation and cross-runtime parity evidence
suites.consumerShape: native app validation targets plus artifact-backed cross-runtime parity evidence rather than runnable downstream adoption
blockers: The repo still lacks a mounted GPUI preview app with route-level acceptance coverage comparable to the Svelte preview surface.
This suite is still artifact-backed rather than runnable downstream production proof.
Downstream GPUI adoption remains future work, so this suite should still be read as validation pressure rather than deployment readiness.

regressionClasses.label: Tokens and theme emission
regressionClasses.scope: schema, generated artifacts, theme posture, and compatibility metadata

regressionClasses.label: Package surface and contract integrity
regressionClasses.scope: public package exports, contract inventories, and README alignment

regressionClasses.label: Preview routes and docs build
regressionClasses.scope: route-based review coverage, generated reports, and preview build posture

regressionClasses.label: Accessibility and keyboard posture
regressionClasses.scope: focus, keyboard, announcement, and cross-runtime accessibility deltas

regressionClasses.label: Downstream boundaries and ownership
regressionClasses.scope: bridge boundaries, extension ownership, and app-specific surface isolation

regressionClasses.label: Release metadata and change control
regressionClasses.scope: release classification, change classes, deprecation workflow, and per-package metadata

regressionClasses.label: Runtime-specific GPUI assumptions
regressionClasses.scope: native app validation pressure, GPUI-specific blockers, and non-browser evidence gaps

ecosystemReadinessGate: Preview docs harness remains buildable and machine-checked.
Underlay bridge and Loophole adoption proofs remain explicit and internally coherent.
GPUI validation remains honest about matrix-only versus runnable evidence.
Accessibility, release operations, and package-surface checks stay aligned with the acceptance suites they support.
